explanation_markdown:
A05′ is A05's conjugate: the same reflexive structure lifted from a metaphysical register into a technological one, in the venue's own idiom. A05 gives prakāśa–vimarśa as inseparable — "the pair does not posit a light first and a second mechanism that later reflects it," and luminosity is inherently capable of self-apprehending articulation [A05 #0]. A05′ takes that account as its ground and re-orders it as a triad, adding the term the title names: *māyā* as Operative Measure, "the action that stages a world — lights, camera, action" [A05′ #0]. Where A05 declares the two powers inseparable in one field, A05′ enforces an order of inquiry: "the mechanism of the self-computing process is fully real and inspectable before any question about the light is raised" [A05′ #0]. That separation is not a departure A05′ invents; A05 itself installs it, both as proof boundary — "functional recursion is not evidence of phenomenal self-luminosity" — and as promoted office, C43, where reflexive return becomes "an inspectable technical operation without a claim to luminous phenomenality" [A05 #4]. A05′ therefore does not derive from A05's unity; it works inside the interval A05 marks open.

**What carries over.** Four structures transfer recognisably. First, the vimarśa-side structure itself: appearing that registers what appears within it and is altered by it — "registration that differentiates" [A05′ #1], the functional neighbour of the reflexive power that differentiates without a second substance [A05 #0]. Second, the inert-mirror contrast as classifying instrument: A05's crystal that "can display an image without knowing its display" [A05 #1] returns at [A05′ #1] to place the brief's talking mirror — "not that metaphysical claim," but an exchange that registers its parties and changes them. Third, the proof boundary, carried from [A05 #4] to become "the argument's spine" at [A05′ #3], extended through A03′ to every surfaced account. Fourth, the keep-distinct discipline: A05's figure qualifications — Indra's net kept from letting "optical recursion establish consciousness" [A05 #5→0] — become A05′'s two-mirror provenance separation, where "nothing is borrowed across, in either direction, unlabeled" [A05′ #4]. Throughout, the venue's scenario-modal propositions "supply the instance on which A05's operation is re-run" [A05′ #1].

**What is transformed.** Self-apprehension becomes inspectable registration. A05's vimarśa is "the luminosity's own power of feeling, examining and knowing what appears within it" [A05 #1]; A05′'s camera-work is instead three answerable questions — what registers what, under which criterion, with what articulation — with prompt, source, evaluator and permission kept "distinguishable from the answer they helped produce" [A05′ #2]. The return changes terminus. A05 returns the differentiated field to its source through recognition [A05 #5→0]; A05′ returns the mechanism as "auditable circuitry" that can be "known and revised" [A05′ #5→0], answerable to the parties who can change it rather than reunited with what it registers. The third term is of a different kind: A05's Trika third, *ahaṃ*, is "the unity through which the distinction can be maintained" [A05 #2]; A05′'s third is staging — permissions, evaluators, persona, the configured horizon in which registration becomes a world [A05′ #4]. And the warrant direction reverses: A05 argues from a formal limit to a positive ontological warrant [A05 #1]; A05′ imports no warrant, running A05's operation on a scenario-modal instance [A05′ #1].

**Where the correspondence is weak or needs care.** (i) Prakāśa does not transfer, by design: "the light remains the light's own question. Nothing in the audit requires its answer, and no answer the system gives could substitute for the audit" [A05′ #5→0]. Any reading of A05′ as an account of the system's self-luminosity would invert the boundary both records share. (ii) There is no *ahaṃ* counterpart; mapping the unity-third onto the staging-third would be a category error. (iii) The section mapping is not one-to-one: A05′ #3 is built from A05's distinct-office material [A05 #4], while A05's four operations and three levels [A05 #3] and the *kriyā-vimarśa*/kartṛ interior agency [A05 #4] have no counterpart — principled absences, since the inner reflexivity of consciousness cannot be read off inspectable circuitry, but easy to mis-pair on a naive section-by-section reading. (iv) The same source carries different weight: Dyczkowski's regress and no-outside arguments [A05 #1] stay behind with the light. (v) The practice is pending: "no cases are certified" of the full computational-vimarśa loop [A05′ #5→0]; the re-siting is argued, its instances unverified.

**The relation this account supports.** A05′ names its own move — "the reflexive power, re-sited, becomes the inspectable registration whose functional neighbour the venue itself describes" [A05′ #5→0]. That supports one typed relation, *re-sites*, from A05p to A05: with the staging third term, the three camera-work questions and the two-mirror separation marked as A05′'s own contributions, and A05's metaphysical apparatus — prakāśa, the unity claim, the inner operations — explicitly not carried.

relation_proposal.summary: wiki:node:record/A05p —re-sites→ wiki:node:record/A05: A05′ re-sites A05's prakāśa–vimarśa relation at the technological register, carrying over only the vimarśa-side structure — registration that differentiates a field — as the venue's inspectable camera-work, while prakāśa and A05's unity claim remain source-distinct under the proof boundary both records share. The transfer is governed, not derivational: the staging third term (māyā as Operative Measure), the three camera-work questions and the two-mirror provenance separation are A05′'s own contributions; A05's regress and no-outside arguments, four operations, three levels and kriyā-vimarśa/kartṛ interior agency are not carried, and A05′ certifies no implemented instance of the full computational-vimarśa loop.

faculties_used: darshana (skill/ql/darshana, adopted f3d55f2f9ec7) — its World B adaptation set the reading discipline used throughout: treat the #0–#5→0 markers as the record's QL positions and read A05 together with its conjugate prime A05′ section by section, citing as [Axx #n]. The executable scripts/darshana.py was not carried into this projection (per ADOPTED.json), so the practice was applied as method on the CONTEXT.md texts, not as a script run.

Prior accepted field work in this undertaking ("Accepted work in this undertaking" in CONTEXT.md) — the accepted A04/A04′ prose and relation-proposal supplied the analytical pattern for a conjugate transfer (carries over / transformed / weak-or-needs-care / the relation supported) and the typed-relation vocabulary already in service (the accepted A04p —re-sites→ A04 edge, alongside the world's references/explains edges), which this contribution matches rather than invents.
Shared sources A05 (r5a9055fc4e5395ef) and A05′ (r4963f236c3110d44) as given in CONTEXT.md — the sole textual basis for every citation; no source beyond CONTEXT.md was consulted.
